sourceDocument: CYC 2026 Participants Guideline & Business Study Case Handbook (Pages 13–22)
methodologyNotes: Anti-Double-Counting Rule (Case Rule #4): Scope 2 energy efficiency (-18%) is deducted first from 2,400.52 tCO2e, leaving 1,968.43 tCO2e residual electricity demand before applying Rooftop Solar PV and I-REC procurement.

Scope 1 Sequential Rule: Boiler WHR & combustion tuning (-16.85%) is deducted first from 3,907.92 tCO2e stationary combustion, leaving 3,249.32 tCO2e before applying biomass co-firing and industrial heat pumps.
Boundary Rule: Category 8 (527.57 tCO2e) and Category 12 (2,551.06 tCO2e) are explicitly excluded from SBTi target compliance calculations per Handbook Page 16.

Offset Rule (Case Rule #6): Zero carbon credits/offsets are counted toward the 2036 SBTi near-term reduction target; all 11,718.12 tCO2e reductions come from direct operational and value-chain interventions.
